style: Friendly rounded flat vector illustration: a dark base colour (#1e1f22), one accent colour (#ffd23f) and white, simple clean shapes, no text, no people, no hands.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a completely plain, smooth engine cover (absolutely no emblem, no badge, no letter, no symbol anywhere); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.
subjects.electricite-electronique: A car battery, an alternator and a starter motor on a workbench with a digital multimeter connected by red and black leads. No hands, no people.

subjects.inspection-mecanique: A clipboard checklist, a flashlight and a tire tread gauge in front of a car wheel on a lift. No hands, no people.

hero: A local repair garage interior: an SUV on a lift, a parts shelf with boxes, a creeper and a floor jack; through a high window, rolling Eastern Townships hills in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#1e1f22), accent highlights (#ffd23f), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
